clips.amharic: አዳምጥ፣ ይህ ነገር ከአንድ ቀን በላይ አይቆይም።
clips.source_text: Listen, this stuff doesn't stay more than a day.
I thought we were gonna cook here.
No, we're not gonna cook here.

clips.amharic: እሺ፣ ይህ የእኔ ቤት ነው። የምበላበትን ቦታ አልቆሽሽም።
clips.source_text: Okay, this is my house. I don't shit where I eat.
Well, then where are we gonna work?

clips.amharic: ይህ የአንተ ነገር ነው። ማጨስ ከፈለግህ በቤትህ አጫስ።
clips.source_text: This is your deal. You wanna smoke it up, smoke it up at your house.
No, I didn't think so. Oh, well.
...what if we rented one of those self-storage places?

clips.amharic: ያ ብርቱካናማ ትንንሽ ጋራዦች? እዚያ ብንሰራ?
clips.source_text: You know, those little orange garages? Worked out of there?

clips.amharic: አይ፣ ያንን አጣርተዋል። ውሻ ይዘው ያሸትባሉ።
clips.source_text: No, they're onto that. They've got dogs that sniff around.

clips.amharic: የራሱን ለመሸጥ የሚፈልግ ሰው አውቃለሁ። እሱ ዝም ብሎ ካምፕ ለመውጣት ይጠቀምበታል።
clips.source_text: I know a dude who wants to sell his. He just goes camping with it.

clips.amharic: ግን ተንቀሳቃሽ የሜት ማምረቻ? ያ ድንቅ ይሆናል!
clips.source_text: But a mobile meth lab? That'd be the bomb.

clips.amharic: ማለቴ፣ በጣም ርቀቅ ብለህ ወደ ገጠራማው ትነዳለህ።
clips.source_text: I mean, you can drive way out in the boonies.

clips.amharic: ሰባት ሺህም አይደለም። ሰውዬዬ ሰማንያ አምስት ይፈልጋል።
clips.source_text: Dude, this isn't even seven grand, all right? My guy wants 85.

clips.amharic: በዓለም ላይ ያለኝ ገንዘብ ሁሉ ይህ ነው።
clips.source_text: This is all the money I have in the world.
You are not how I remember you from class.
I mean, like, not at all.
Tell me why you're doing this. Seriously.

clips.amharic: እንዳንተ ያለ ቀጥተኛ ሰው፣ ደረቱ ጠጣር...
clips.source_text: Some straight like you, giant stick up his ass...
...all a sudden at age, what, 60, he's just gonna break bad?
...I mean, if you've gone crazy, or depressed.
That's something I need to know about.
Okay, I mean, that affects me.
Get off me! Get off me!
Do you want me or your dad?
So how are those feeling in the waist? Are they too tight?
You don't want to get them if they're too tight.

clips.amharic: አንድ ዕድል ብቻ ነው ያለህ። በሚገባ ተጠቀምበት።
clips.source_text: You'll have one shot. You'd better make it good.
Are you sure you don't want the... Like a different kind?
Like, you know, the skinny jeans...

clips.amharic: ምን እየጠበቅክ ነው? የሴት ጓደኞችህን? ሂድ።
clips.source_text: You waiting for, your girlfriends? Better go.
...because those are in style. The skaters where them.
Do I look like a skater?
You'd better go. Take it. Take your shot. Take it!
Mom, get them, my big boy pants.

clips.amharic: እማዬ፣ የትልቅ ልጅ ሱሪዬን ስፌቱን ትዘጋጂልኝ?
clips.source_text: Mommy, could you zip up my big boy pants.
Come on. Come on, let's get out of here.
No, you know what? Don't even look at them.

clips.amharic: እኔ እንደማስበው... ያ ጂንስ በአንተ ላይ በጣም ጥሩ ይመስላል።
clips.source_text: I think that... I think those jeans look really good on you.
I think you should get them if you like them, okay?

clips.amharic: ለአንድ ደቂቃ እዚህ ቆይ። ወዲያውኑ እመለሳለሁ።
clips.source_text: Why don't you hang out here for a second. I'll be right back.

clips.amharic: እማዬ፣ በአዲሱ የትልቅ ልጅ ሱሪዬ ውስጥ ሰገራ ያዘሁ ይመስለኛል!
clips.source_text: Hey, Mommy, I think I pinched a loaf in my brand new big boy pants.

clips.amharic: ወደዚያ አቅጣጫ ትልቅ የላም ቤት አለ፣ ሁለት ማይል ያህል...
clips.source_text: Got some big cow house way out that way, like two miles...

clips.amharic: እሺ ይሁን። ውይ፣ አዎ። እዚህ እንበስል።
clips.source_text: Whatever, man. Shit, yeah. Let's cook here.

clips.amharic: የሜት ማምረቻ ሸታ ይዘህ ቤት መሄድ አትችልም።
clips.source_text: You can't go home smelling like a meth lab.

clips.amharic: እነዚህ? ዋው። እነዚህን... ሳትቀይር ትቀጥላለህ አይደል?
clips.source_text: Those? Wow. Those... You're keeping those on right?

clips.amharic: ዋው፣ ይህ መልክ ለአንተ ጥሩ ነው።
clips.source_text: Wow, this is a good look for you.

clips.amharic: ማለቴ፣ ምናልባት በዓለም ሁለተኛው ትልቁ ግብረ ሰዶማዊ ነህ ብቻ።
clips.source_text: I mean, you're maybe only the world's second-biggest homo.
Would you shut up and help me?

clips.amharic: ውስጡ... ኢየሱስ፣ ሁለት ኢንች፣ ሶስት ኢንች ርዝመት ያላቸው ክሪስታሎች አሉበት።
clips.source_text: You got... Jesus, you got crystals in here two inches, three inches long.

clips.amharic: እንዳውቅህ፣ ይህ መሰረታዊ ኬሚስትሪ ብቻ ነው...
clips.source_text: Well, actually, it's just basic chemistry...

clips.amharic: …ግን አመሰግናለሁ፣ ጄሲ። የሚገባ መሆኑ ደስ ብሎኛል።
clips.source_text: ...but thank you, Jesse. I'm glad it's acceptable.

clips.amharic: የሚገባ? አንተ እውነተኛው አይሮን ቼፍ ነህ!
clips.source_text: Acceptable? You're the goddamn Iron Chef.

clips.amharic: ከዚህ እስከ ቲምቡክቱ ያለ ሰው ሁሉ ሊቀምሰው ይፈልጋል።
clips.source_text: Every jibhead from here to Timbuktu's gonna want a taste.
No. We only sell it. We don't use it.
Listen, you've been watching way too much Miami Vice.
...I know just the guy to talk to.
Hey, yo. Kraze, how you doing, my man?

clips.amharic: ሄይ፣ አዲስ ውሻ አለህ። ጥሩ ነው፣ ወንድሜ።
clips.source_text: Hey, you got a new dog. Right on, man.

clips.amharic: ቀድሞ እንደዚህ ውሻ ነበረኝ፣ ግን ሁለት እጥፍ ትልቅ።
clips.source_text: Yeah, I had a dog like that once, except maybe like twice as big.

clips.amharic: እኔ በራሴ ብሆን ቀጥታ ወደ ወርች እንዲሄድ አሰለጥነው ነበር።
clips.source_text: Now, me personally, I would train him to go straight for the nutsack.
Just shut your mouth and show me your money.

clips.amharic: ይህ ያየኸው ምርጥ ስካንቴ አይደለም ብለህ ንገረኝ።
clips.source_text: Tell me that ain't the finest scante you ever laid eyes on.
Yeah. Booya! See, what'd I say?
It's all right? Yeah, it's all right.
So what? You're back in business?
With a vengeance. Vato loco gotta make a living.
You know, with your cousin gone away and all...
Really broke me up about Emilio.
That dude is like my brother.
You okay? You talk to him?

clips.amharic: ፌዴራሎቹ ሲመጡ አንተ በጎረቤት ሴት ላይ ጠመዝቀህ ነበር አለ።
clips.source_text: Said when the feds came, you were out sticking it in some neighbour lady.

clips.amharic: ሄይ፣ ታውቃለህ፣ ሁለት ጊዜ ዕድል አግኝቻለሁ።
clips.source_text: Hey, you know, I got lucky twice.
...he thinks maybe you dimed on him.

clips.amharic: ዋው፣ ዋው፣ ሄይ፣ ሄይ። ያ ውሸት ነው።
clips.source_text: Whoa, whoa, hey, hey. That is bullshit.

clips.amharic: ያንን ለማሰቡ እንኳ አንጀቱን ልበጥበጥ ነበረብኝ።
clips.source_text: I should kick his punk ass for even thinking that.
You know what? Next time you talk to Emilio...
...you tell him for me, all right?

clips.amharic: ለምን ራስህ አትነግረውም? ዛሬ ጠዋት በዋስ ወጥቷል።
clips.source_text: Why don't you tell him yourself? Made bail this morning.
Go ahead, pendejo. Kick my ass.

clips.amharic: አንተ ቆሻሻ ልጅ ያበሰልከው አይደለም ብዬ አውቃለሁ።
clips.source_text: Because I know your little punk ass didn't cook it.

clips.amharic: ውይ፣ ወንድሜ። ምን ነህ፣ ራቁታኛ ነህ?
clips.source_text: Damn, man. What are you, some kind of nudist?

clips.amharic: አዎ፣ በጣም ጥሩ ቲክ-ቲክ ነው ያበሰልከው፣ ኤሴ።
clips.source_text: Yeah, that's some stone-fine tick-tick you been cooking there, ese.
How about you come work for me?
I'd be willing to sell it to you...
Out here all by yourself, huh?

clips.amharic: ሄይ፣ አንተን አውቅሃለሁ። ሲይዙኝ እሱም እዚያ ነበር።
clips.source_text: Hey, I know you. He was there when I got busted.
I say we cap them both.
You really cook up that batch?
Listen to me. I'll teach you my recipe, huh?

clips.amharic: ምን ትላለህ? እንደ እኔ ማብሰል ትፈልጋለህ?
clips.source_text: What do you say? You wanna cook like me?

video streams are copied, never re-encoded; the source's own audio streams are replaced by the Amharic mix

omnivoice runs voice cloning: each character is spoken in their own voice, cloned from their isolated performance in the film, so the dub carries that performance's accent as well as its timbre. A character whose film audio cannot supply a clean reference is cast from a native-Amharic bank instead, and the profile records which source each voice came from
loudness normalization (EBU R128) is not applied: the mix is placed at a defined peak with defined dialogue and bed levels
clip paths are content-addressed artifacts of the tts stage, so later runs of the same lines reuse them instead of re-synthesizing

a line whose Amharic needs more time than the film gave it is moved later rather than being spoken over the next line, because two voices at once cannot be understood; the shift is recorded per line as 'drift'. The exception is a pair the film itself overlapped: that simultaneity is the performance, so it is kept rather than serialized, and qc.overlap measures how much of it survived

speech the film played simultaneously is recovered for the character the exclusive diarization had to drop, written as a short competing line, and placed at the same instant as the line it overlaps; when CROSSTALK_SEPARATION is enabled the two voices are separated first and the missing character's own track is transcribed, and the register gate still refuses any track that does not measure as that character; qc.overlap.unpaired names any crosstalk where only one character is heard
the qc block is measured, not assumed; pronunciation is left unmeasured because it needs an Amharic ASR model, which is injected by the caller rather than downloaded by a run
